raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--attn-dp-size > 1`, DFlash keeps the draft eager on every device, and any DP round with an idle rank falls back to eager target verify on all ranks.

Eager execution drops most of the DFlash speedup. A drafted block of tokens only pays off when draft and verify are cheap per step, and eager launch overhead dominates at small batch sizes, which is where DP ranks go idle. On base main, at concurrency 1 (an idle rank in every round), the 27B DFlash2 pair outputs 24.81 tok/s at 38.96 ms median TPOT; with graphs it outputs 210.43 tok/s at 4.12 ms (see Speed Tests).

Neither fallback is required. The draft runs attn-TP-local (`draft_tp_context`) with no cross-DP collective, so each DP rank can replay its own draft graph keyed by local batch size, as the DSpark dense draft already does. For verify, this PR follows DSpark's idle-rank handling: the idle rank runs a dummy verify padded to the same graph bucket as the active ranks, so all ranks replay the verify graph and the DP-gather offsets agree.

## Modifications

- `DecodeCudaGraphRunner._forward_is_dp_local` returns True for the DFlash draft runner, so draft graphs are keyed by local batch size, as for the DSpark dense draft. Without this, the hand-built draft batch has no `original_global_num_tokens_cpu` and DP replay rejects it.
- `DFlashWorkerV2.init_cuda_graphs`: on CUDA, capture the draft decode graph under DP attention. Non-CUDA devices keep the eager draft.
- Idle DP rank verify: on CUDA, stop forcing eager. The idle rank and the active ranks pick the same padded bucket from the gathered max DP batch, so DP-gather offsets agree. `can_run_cuda_graph` is propagated from the idle verify result.
- The active-rank idle-DP guard (eager verify when any DP rank has 0 tokens) is now NPU-only, matching NPU idle ranks, which still verify eagerly.
- The mixed prefill/verify round guard is unchanged.
- Docs: update the "DFlash and DFlash2 with DP attention" section.
- Unit tests in `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_dp_attention.py` cover the draft graph policy per device, local-batch graph keying, and idle-rank verify graph vs eager per device.

## Accuracy Tests

Tested commit e4283151a6cd7b992756219a5150bf4174823ee1, based on main e2982985110fb432fd8ddba5f0147a5004fd03ab. GPU runs used 4 × NVIDIA B30Z (SM103) with TP4 / attention DP2.

### Unit tests (CPU)


| Tests | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `test/registered/unit/spec/`: `test_dflash_*.py` (including the new `test_dflash_dp_attention.py` cases), `test_minimax_dflash.py`, `test_oot_dflash_hooks.py`, `test_draft_tp_context.py` | 103 passed, 1 failed (also fails on base main, unrelated) |
| `test/registered/unit/model_executor/runner/test_decode_cuda_graph_runner.py` | 27 passed |
| pre-commit on changed files | Passed |

The unrelated failure is `test_dflash_model_config.py::test_gemma_attention_and_npu_context_preparation_share_correct_qk_math`.


```bash
python test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_dp_attention.py
```

### E2E tests (GPU)

`test/registered/e2e/speculative/test_dflash_dp_attention.py`, with a deterministic Triton target and FlashInfer draft, compared against target-only at the same TP/DP layout:

| Target / draft | Greedy token IDs compared | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` / `z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16` | 320 | Exact match |
| `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` / `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` | 320 | Exact match |

Each fixture also passed a 64-token sampled smoke (temperature 0.7, `spec_verify_ct > 0`). Cases cover individual DP replicas with an idle peer in both rank directions, concurrent unequal lengths and prefix reuse, with target CUDA graphs enabled. Both e2e cases passed in 300 s. On all 4 ranks the draft graph was captured (`Capture draft verify CUDA graph end. bs=[1, 2, 3, 4]`, 0.05 GB per rank for the 4B draft and 0.19 GB for the 27B draft), the "Disable DFLASH draft cuda graph" warning did not appear, and every logged decode batch reported `cuda graph: True`.

```bash
python test/registered/e2e/speculative/test_dflash_dp_attention.py
```

Deviations from the registered e2e config, needed on this machine:
- `--attention-backend triton` instead of `fa3`: fa3 requires SM80-90, and fa4 fails with `SM100 forward with head_dim=256 does not support seqused_q/seqused_k`.
- The 27B pair was loaded from local copies without `--revision`; the 4B pair used the pinned HF revisions.

### Accuracy (GSM8K)

`sgl-eval==0.1.3` (the version pinned in the `test` extra), against the same TP4 / attention DP2 DFlash2 server as the speed tests below, plus `--reasoning-parser qwen3`:

| Commit | `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` / `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` GSM8K | Truncated | Decode batches with `cuda graph: False` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| base main e29829851 | 96.50% | 2/200 | 8 |
| this PR e4283151a | 96.50% | 4/200 | 0 |

```bash
sgl-eval run gsm8k \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:31000/v1 \
  --num-examples 200 \
  --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --seed 42 \
  --max-tokens 7680 \
  --chat-template-kwarg enable_thinking=true
```

Sampling follows the model's `generation_config.json` (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95; the server applies top_k 20). Thinking is on, the template default. `--max-tokens 7680` fits the 8192 context length. sgl-eval has no preset for this model. Each score comes from one sampled run, so the 1-5% run-to-run variance of this sanity check applies.

### Environment

Environment: driver 580.178.04, Torch 2.14.1+cu130, FlashInfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10, DeepEP 0.1.2.post1, DeepGEMM 0.2.3.post2, Triton 3.8.0 and Transformers 5.19.0.



## Speed Tests and Profiling

Tested commit e4283151a6cd7b992756219a5150bf4174823ee1 against base main e2982985110fb432fd8ddba5f0147a5004fd03ab, same server flags and the same machine.

GPU: 4 × NVIDIA B30Z (SM103), `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` target with `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` draft, TP4 / attention DP2. `bench_serving` on ShareGPT, output length 256, seed 42, 2 warmup requests, `num-prompts >= 5 * max-concurrency`:

| Concurrency | Prompts | Output tok/s (main → PR) | Speedup | Median TPOT ms (main → PR) | Median TTFT ms (main → PR) | Accept length (main / PR) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 16 | 24.81 → 210.43 | 8.48x | 38.96 → 4.12 | 265.31 → 139.29 | 3.32 / 3.32 |
| 2 | 16 | 190.98 → 386.00 | 2.02x | 7.88 → 4.65 | 283.81 → 145.74 | 3.36 / 3.36 |
| 8 | 40 | 655.42 → 766.64 | 1.17x | 9.66 → 7.98 | 177.98 → 159.03 | 3.56 / 3.51 |
| 16 | 80 | 962.43 → 1416.96 | 1.47x | 12.71 → 9.73 | 188.01 → 172.22 | 3.57 / 3.56 |

At concurrency 1, every DP round has an idle rank. On main, that round runs both the draft and target verify eagerly on all ranks. With this change, both replay CUDA graphs. Accept length is unchanged, so the gain comes from graph replay, not from different drafts. On main, the server logged "Disable DFLASH draft cuda graph because dp attention is enabled" and 32 decode batches with `cuda graph: False`. With this change, the draft graph was captured for bs 1-16 (0.28 GB per rank) and every decode batch logged `cuda graph: True`.

Server:

```bash
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
  --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \
  --speculative-draft-model-path incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 8 \
  --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer \
  --tp-size 4 --attn-dp-size 2 --enable-dp-lm-head \
  --attention-backend triton \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --context-length 8192 --max-running-requests 32
```

Client, for (C, N) in (1, 16), (2, 16), (8, 40), (16, 80):

```bash
python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang \
  --dataset-name sharegpt --sharegpt-output-len 256 \
  --num-prompts N --max-concurrency C \
  --warmup-requests 2 --seed 42
```


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+    def test_cuda_idle_rank_replays_verify_graph(self):
